Mohan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 12
September, 2024

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:63141
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9625 of 2024
Applicant :- Mohan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Complaint No.1458 of 2022, under Section 376, 504,
506, 354C of IPC, P.S. Motipur, District Bahraich.

3. In terms of the FIR lodged through an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. dated 15.06.2022 it was alleged that on 02.01.2022 at about 2 in the afternoon when the victim was changing her clothes, the applicant took some photographs and thereafter, under the threat of making photo viral,
formed physical relations with her.
The tentative age of the victim is around 32 years.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
Mohan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Mohan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5. Considering the inordinate delay in lodging the FIR and the age of the victim which is around 32 years, the applicant who is in custody since 05.08.2024 is entitled to be enlarged on bail, more so,
when the applicant has not even been charged under the Information Technology Act.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Mohan be released on bail in aforesaid complaint number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.9.2024 nishant  Mohan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
